CHEESE HOTDOG BITES

المكونات: 4 cups shredded mozarella + 6 tbsp cream cheese + 2 eggs + 1/2 cup almond flour + 2 tsp baking powder + 1 tsp salt + 8 hotdogs + 4 tbsp melted butter + 1 tsp garlic powder
التحضير: 1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees, line a baking tray with a parchment paper. 2. In a large microwave-safe bowl, melt together mozzarella and cream cheese. 3. التحضير: 1. 2. Place the chopped chocolate or chocolate chips in a microwavesafe bowl. Microwave in 15-second bursts, stirring between each and watching carefully so that the chocolate does not burn.
